column1: # Signed, directed regulatory edges for the CD8 T-cell exhaustion/effector module.
# Real PPI from STRING/BioGRID is UNDIRECTED and UNSIGNED, so it cannot be turned
# into Boolean logic directly. To auto-generate a Boolean model you need causal,
# signed, directed edges -- the kind found in SIGNOR / Reactome causal / OmniPath.
# This file is that layer (hand-curated here from the cited literature).
# Columns: source  target  sign   (+ = activates, - = inhibits)
# Confidence is taken as 1.0 for all curated edges; add a 4th column to weight.
# The block below the genes are DECOY housekeeping hubs (ACTB, GAPDH, TUBB):
# high-degree but NOT differentially expressed, included to show that
# differential RWR filters degree-biased hubs out of the top ranking.
